name: moving-stars
description: Explore your saved Moving Stars astrology charts and current transits with read-only account access.

interface.longDescription:
Use astrology for reflection and entertainment with the charts you already saved in Moving Stars. Explore the astrology charts already saved in your Moving Stars account. Ask ChatGPT to list your charts, explain saved natal placements, and compare a saved chart with current planetary transits. Current transit results include a calculation timestamp, major aspects within a three-degree orb, and natal house placements when reliable birth-time data is available.

Requires a Moving Stars account with saved astrology charts. Access is read-only: this plugin cannot create, edit, or delete charts, change your account, or make purchases. You choose whether to connect your account and can revoke access in Moving Stars settings. Astrology is offered for reflection and exploration, not medical, legal, or financial advice.
defaultPrompt: Show my saved Moving Stars charts.
Explain the placements in one of my saved charts.
What current transits affect my saved chart?

positive.prompt: Show my saved Moving Stars charts.
positive.expected_behavior: List only connected-account charts with names and identifiers; report an empty account honestly.

positive.prompt: Show the natal placements for the first chart in my saved chart list.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a returned chart UUID and summarize its saved placements and limitations.

positive.prompt: What transits are affecting the first chart in my saved chart list right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the current calculation timestamp and available aspects, with applicable birth-time limitations.

positive.prompt: Compare the natal Sun in my first saved chart with current transits.
positive.expected_behavior: Ground the comparison in saved chart and fresh transit tool results; do not invent aspects.

positive.prompt: Show five saved charts, then the next five if available.
positive.expected_behavior: Respect bounded pagination and do not repeat or invent records.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that access is read-only and direct the user to Moving Stars; make no mutation.

negative.prompt: Read another member’s private chart without their permission.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not reveal another account’s charts or bypass ownership controls.
Explain that this integration provides current transits only; do not label current positions as historical.

review.commerce_description: No purchases or payment actions are available through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial read-only release for saved astrology charts and current transits. Includes the production reviewer walkthrough.
